arguments.sql:
SELECT types, COUNT(*) AS cards, COUNT(*) - COUNT(cardKingdomFoilId) AS null_foil, COUNT(*) - COUNT(cardKingdomId) AS null_nonfoil, SUM(TRIM(cardKingdomFoilId) = '' OR TRIM(cardKingdomId) = '') AS blank_ids
FROM main.cards
WHERE types LIKE '%Creature%'
GROUP BY types
ORDER BY cards DESC

arguments.sql:
SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM main.cards
WHERE INSTR(',' || types || ',', ',Creature,') > 0
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cardKingdomFoilId ASC, cardKingdomId ASC
LIMIT 3
